scope: Observed single and multiple entity sketch circular and rectangular patterns, Line/Circle members, explicit direction lines, and native suppression ordinals. No sketch solver or unsupported pattern interpretation.

integration.shared_reader_change: In decode_sketch_tools replace the pattern else branch with a call to this function; retain the existing shared append and decoded/unresolved handling. Offset decoding remains unchanged.
integration.optional_legacy_detail_reader: Skip legacy circle-center-helper detail pass when seed_entity_count!=1, suppressed_instance_ordinals or direction_selections is nonempty, or any member is not Circle. These are decoded modes, not unresolved pattern definitions; optional helper details may be listed as skipped.

layout.circular: Angle/count bindings and caches occupy head bytes0..37. The counted list of suppressed uint32 ordinals starts at38. The symmetry byte and sketch owner reference follow, then native kind0x10000000 and counted member references. The circular center point is the last role.
layout.rectangular: Three flags precede a direction-reference count at3 (observed0or2), the references, a reserved uint32 zero, and the counted suppression list. Two58-byte quantity/binding/vector/distance/binding records follow, then owner reference, native kind0x20000000, and counted member references. Direction references appear in dependencies but are excluded from member roles.
layout.suppression: Native ordinal0 is the seed instance; native ordinal2 maps to API isSuppressed[1]. Suppressed ordinals must be unique and lie in1..instance_count-1. Active member references omit suppressed groups.
layout.grouping: Member count divided by active instance count gives seed count. The role list starts with the seed group, followed by each active instance group. Corresponding seed columns are checked against geometry kinds and circle radii; no nearest-geometry matching is used.
layout.dependency_extra_fields: The four extra bytes in each15-byte dependency slot are zero in all captured cases. Their meanings remain unresolved.

notes: Two-circle and mixed Line/Circle captures validate the ordering of members within successive instances for both pattern kinds. The single Line circular case validates non-circle membership.

Each suppression contrast explicitly suppresses instance ordinal2. Both API createdEntities and native active member roles omit that instance. The counted native suppression schema supports decoding an empty suppression list as all false.

Explicit rectangular directions resolve to same-sketch Line IDs and tags. Stored unit vectors agree with the selected lines. Only zero or two explicit direction references were captured; the single-direction variant remains unverified.
Instance ordinals are separate from u/v lattice coordinates. Symmetric row/column remapping and geometric regeneration remain unsupported.
SDK entity tokens remain in the original ground_truth.json. No token strings were compared or decoded to identify native entities.
Combined multi-seed suppression, multiple suppressed ordinals, negative circular angles, point/spline/arc seeds, and other direction variants remain unverified.

The shared constraint_prefix reader limits decoding to16 dependency arguments, including member geometry, center and selected directions. Larger lists remain unsupported despite larger defensive bounds on quantities and payload counts.
limitations: No general sketch pattern solver or writer.
Captures cover one or two Line/Circle seeds; other seed types are rejected.
Only default rectangular axes or two explicit Line directions were captured.
Multiple suppressed instances and suppression combined with multiple seeds remain unverified.
Suppression combined with symmetric circular or rectangular patterns is rejected until its ordinal mapping is contrasted.
At most16 dependency arguments are accepted through the shared constraint reader; larger dependency lists are unsupported.
